name: Synesius the Philosopher
bio: Synesius of Cyrene was a Neoplatonist philosopher, orator and poet who later became bishop of Ptolemais. Paton’s Index of Authors lists him as Synesius the Philosopher and dates him to the 5th century AD.
This archive carries the 2 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 76, 79.

poems.title: Book XVI, 76
poems.author: Synesius the Philosopher
poems.text: The three children of Tyndareus, Castor, Helen, and Pollux.

poems.title: Book XVI, 79: On his Sister
poems.author: Synesius the Philosopher
poems.text: The statue is of golden Cypris or of golden Stratonice.
